question: Should pending-approval Skill Workshop lifecycle actions become version-bound so revising a proposal invalidates an already-issued approve, reject, or quarantine prompt?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes approval completion semantics to prevent an operator from acting on content different from what they reviewed; that safety-versus-continuity contract needs owner acceptance rather than a mechanical review fix.

options.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
options.body: Keep the fail-closed version snapshot so operators must review the newest proposal revision before completing a lifecycle action.

options.title: Preserve legacy prompt completion
options.body: Allow previously issued pending-approval prompts to act on later revisions, accepting that the decision may no longer match the reviewed content.

options.title: Pause for a narrower contract
options.body: Hold this PR until the owner specifies which lifecycle actions, if any, should require version binding.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed version snapshot so operators must review the newest proposal revision before completing a lifecycle action.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the adjacent Skill Workshop approval-policy behavior that this PR extends.
